column1: # THE PRE-1879 BAPTISM INDEX - opened 13 September 2026, and read END TO END the same day.
# FamilySearch film 004530324, 554 images. Title card at image 5:
#   "Parroquia N. S. del Rosario - INDICE DE BAUTISMOS - VOLUMEN 3o - Anos 1731-1879 -
#    LETRAS L-Q - Revisado y Restaurado en 1945"
# WHY IT MATTERS: this is the only index covering Rosario baptisms BEFORE 1879. It is where
# Juan Carlos Lerena's own baptism would be if he was born in the city, and where any older
# sibling of Pablo Armando born in the 1870s would be.
# TYPEWRITTEN, like the 1879-1900 volume - the 1945 restoration. Columns: APELLIDOS | NOMBRES |
# ANO | FOLIO. Read by the DeepZoom tile method at level 12, scale 0.42, whole opening per screen;
# anything ambiguous re-rendered at level 13.
# *** THE L SECTION IS NOW CLOSED. *** It runs from image 6 to image 85; image 86 begins the M
# section (Libro 1o, 1751). Every opening from 6 to 85 has been opened and read. Two of them
# (63 and 83) are duplicate exposures. Two are duplicated across the roll break (34 and 43).
# *** THE RESULT. *** In a hundred and forty-eight years of Rosario baptisms - 1731 to 1879 -
# the surname LERENA appears exactly ONCE:
#     LERENA LENGUAS, Maria Julia Margarita Josefa E.J.  -  1866, Libro 15, folio 229
#     (cross-indexed a line above under LENGUAS, same child, same folio)
# That is the only Lerena baptised in Rosario before 1879. Combined with the 1879-1901 volume,
# already read end to end and also empty of Lerenas, it means: across the ENTIRE surviving
# baptism index of the parish, 1731 to 1901, there is one Lerena, and she is not Pablo Armando.
# A TECHNICAL NOTE WORTH KEEPING: the tile-retry loop must re-request the SAME url. Appending a
# cache-busting query returns a different tile and silently scrambles the mosaic - it produced one
# unreadable, misaligned page before it was caught.
